title: Madinah Aane Waala Hay
roman: Sambhal jaa ay dil-e-muztar Madinah aane waala hai
Lutaa ay chashm-e-tar gouhar Madinah aane waala hai
Qadam ban jaaye mera sar Madinah aane waala hai
Bichun rah mein nazar ban kar Madinah aane waala hai
Jo dekhe un ka naqsh-e-paa Khuda se woh nazar maangun
Charaagh-e-dil chalun le kar Madinah aane waala hai
Karam un ka chala yun dil se kehta raah-e-Taybah mein
Dil-e-muztar tasalli kar Madinah aane waala hai
Nichaawar hain Madine ki ye mera dil meri aankhen
Nichaawar hoon Madine par Madinah aane waala hai
Ilaahi main talab gaar-e-fanaa hoon khaak-e-Taybah mein
Ilaahi kar nisaar-e-dar Madinah aane waala hai
Madine ko chala main be niyaaz-e-rehbar-e-manzil
Rah-e-Taybah hai khud rehbar Madinah aane waala hai
Mujhey khinchey liye jaata hai shouq-e-koocha-e-jaanaan
Khincha jaata hoon main yaksar Madinah aane waala hai
Woh chamka gumbad-e-khazraa woh shehr-e-pur ziyaa aaya
Dhaley ab noor mein paykar Madinah aane waala hai
Jahaan se be khabar ho kar chalo khuld-e-Madinah mein
Chalo ab hosh ki pee kar Madinah aane waala hai
Madine mein khuley baab-e-hayaat-e-nao ba tarz-e-nao
Badal daalo kuhan daftar Madinah aane waala hai
Zara ay markab-e-umr-e-rawaan chal barq ki surat
Dikhaa parwaaz ke jouhar Madinah aane waala hai
Talab gaar-e-Madinah tak Madinah khud hi aajaaye
Tu dunya se kinaarah kar Madinah aane waala hai
Madinah aagaya ab deyr kya hai sirf itni si
Tu khaali kar ye dil ka ghar Madinah aane waala hai
Falak shayad zameen par rah gaya khaak-e-guzar ban kar
Bichey hain raah me Akhtar Madinah aane waala hai
Fizaayen mehki mehki hain hawaayen bheeni bheeni hain
Basi hai kaisi mushk-e-tar Madinah aane waala hai
Qamar aaya hai shayad un ke talwon ki ziyaa lene
Bichaa hai chaand ka bistar Madinah aane waala hai
Muhammad ke gadaa kuch farsh waaley hi nahin dekho
Woh aata hai shah-e-khaawar Madinah aane waala hai
Ghubaar-e-raah-e-anwar kis qadar pur noor hai Akhtar
Tani hai noor ki chaadar Madinah aane waala hai
